disclaimer: Preparation baseline: official 2025 recruitment notice, checked 12 September 2026. Its exams were in January/February 2026. This is a reusable preparation plan, not an announced next-attempt calendar. Confirm any newer notice on the SEBI vacancies page. Supplementary CS and interview topics are labelled separately.

phases.name: Phase I — screening
phases.nature: Two objective papers; screening marks do not enter final merit.
phases.note: Minimum cut-offs: Paper 1 30%, Paper 2 40%, aggregate 40%. Wrong objective answers lose one-quarter of the marks assigned.

papers.name: Paper 1 — common aptitude
papers.contents: General awareness, English, quantitative aptitude and reasoning.

papers.name: Paper 2 — IT
papers.contents: IT objective questions; indicative topic weights are listed below.

phases.name: Phase II — main examination
phases.note: Paper weights: English 1/3; IT 2/3. Minimums: English 30%, IT 40%, weighted aggregate 50%. IT wrong answers carry one-quarter negative marking.

papers.name: Paper 1 — English drafting
papers.contents: Descriptive writing; consult the handout for task types.

papers.name: Paper 2 — IT objective
papers.contents: Code tracing, debugging, logic and data-analysis MCQs.

phases.name: Phase III — interview
phases.note: Practice factual profile answers, technical explanations and informed judgement.

subjects.name: General Awareness & Securities Market
subjects.weightNote: Practise financial awareness alongside the other common-paper sections. No fixed internal GA topic weights are assumed.

topics.name: Indian financial system: structure, regulators, intermediaries
SEBI: establishment, objectives, structure, powers & functions
SEBI Act 1992 — key sections, penalties, SAT appeals
Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act 1956 & SCRR
Depositories Act 1996, NSDL/CDSL, dematerialisation
Primary market: IPO, FPO, book building, ASBA, UPI, red herring prospectus
Secondary market: exchanges, indices, trading, clearing & settlement, T+1/T+0
Market instruments: equity, debt, G-sec, REITs, InvITs, AT1 bonds
Derivatives: futures, options, payoffs, margins, F&O regulation
Mutual funds, AIFs, PMS, index funds & ETFs
Key SEBI regulations: LODR, ICDR, PIT, SAST, PFUTP
Investor protection, grievance redressal (SCORES), IPEF, ODR
RBI, monetary policy, banking system, NBFCs
Other regulators: IRDAI, PFRDA, IBBI, FSDC, IFSCA
Indian economy basics: GDP, inflation, budget, fiscal & external sector
Static GK: HQs, heads, schemes, indices, awards, abbreviations
Current affairs method: 6-month window, sources, note-making
Reading comprehension strategy & speed
Cloze test & sentence completion
Error spotting & sentence correction
Para jumbles & sentence rearrangement
Fillers, synonyms, antonyms, idioms & phrases
Core grammar rules: tense, S-V agreement, prepositions, modifiers
Number system, simplification, approximation
Percentage, ratio & proportion, averages
Profit & loss, SI & CI, mixtures & alligation
Time-speed-distance, time & work, pipes & cisterns
Data Interpretation: tables, bar, line, pie, caselets
Quadratic equations & number series
Permutation, combination & probability
Mensuration & basic algebra
Speed maths: tables, squares, cubes, fraction-percent conversions
Puzzles: seating arrangement (linear, circular, square)
Puzzles: floor, box, scheduling, month/day based
Syllogism (including reverse & possibility cases)
Inequality (direct & coded)
Coding-decoding, blood relations, direction sense
Order & ranking, alphanumeric series, input-output
Data sufficiency & statement-based (assumption, conclusion, course of action)

subjects.name: English — Descriptive (Phase II Paper 1)
subjects.weightNote: Practise typing and self-review from the beginning. English has one-third of Phase II weighting.

topics.name: Essay writing: structure, intro-body-conclusion, argument balance
Essay banks: markets, technology, regulation, economy themes
Précis writing: 1/3 rule, title, indirect speech
Comprehension passages (descriptive answers)
Formal letters, reports, office correspondence
C fundamentals: data types, operators, control flow, functions
Pointers, arrays, strings, memory model, dynamic allocation
Recursion, scope, storage classes, parameter passing
OOP: class, object, encapsulation, abstraction
Inheritance, polymorphism, overloading vs overriding, virtual functions
Java essentials: JVM/JRE/JDK, collections, exceptions, threads
Python essentials: data structures, comprehensions, modules, libraries
Output-based & code-tracing questions practice
C++ fundamentals, references and object lifetime
Complexity analysis: Big-O, Θ, Ω, recurrence & Master theorem
Arrays, linked lists (single, double, circular)
Stacks, queues, deques, priority queues & applications
Trees: BST, AVL, B/B+ trees, heaps, traversals
Hashing: functions, collision resolution, load factor
Graphs: representation, BFS/DFS, MST, shortest paths, topological sort
Sorting: bubble, insertion, merge, quick, heap, counting — complexity & stability
Searching, divide & conquer, greedy, dynamic programming, backtracking
Classic DP problems: knapsack, LCS, LIS, matrix chain, coin change
String operations, pattern matching, matrix and JSON tracing

subjects.name: Database Management Systems
subjects.paper: Phase I IT; selected material also supports interview

topics.name: DBMS architecture, data independence, ER & EER modelling
Relational model, keys, integrity constraints, relational algebra
SQL: DDL, DML, joins, subqueries, aggregates, group by/having
Advanced SQL: views, indexes, triggers, stored procedures, window functions
Normalisation: functional dependency, 1NF→BCNF, 4NF, decomposition
Transactions: ACID, schedules, serialisability, recovery
Concurrency control: locking, 2PL, deadlock, timestamp, MVCC
Indexing & file organisation: B+ tree, hashing, clustered vs non-clustered
NoSQL, data warehousing, OLAP vs OLTP, distributed DB & CAP

subjects.name: Computer Networks
subjects.paper: Phase I IT; selected material also supports interview

topics.name: OSI & TCP/IP models, layer functions, encapsulation
Physical layer, transmission media, topologies, switching
Data link layer: framing, error detection (CRC, checksum), flow control, ARQ
MAC: Ethernet, CSMA/CD, CSMA/CA, switches, VLAN, ARP
Network layer: IPv4 addressing, subnetting, CIDR, NAT, IPv6
Routing: distance vector, link state, OSPF, BGP, RIP
Transport layer: TCP vs UDP, handshake, congestion & flow control
Application layer: DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SMTP, FTP, DHCP, SNMP
Network security devices: firewall, IDS/IPS, VPN, proxy, DMZ
Wireless, mobile networks, 5G, SDN, network troubleshooting tools

subjects.name: Operating Systems

topics.name: OS functions, types, kernel, system calls, modes
Processes, PCB, states, context switching, threads
CPU scheduling: FCFS, SJF, SRTF, priority, RR — numericals
Synchronisation: race condition, critical section, semaphores, monitors
Deadlock: conditions, prevention, avoidance (Banker's), detection
Memory: contiguous allocation, paging, segmentation, TLB
Virtual memory, page replacement (FIFO, LRU, Optimal), thrashing
File systems, directory structures, disk scheduling (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN)
I/O management, RAID levels, Linux/Windows basics & commands
